documents.describes: Authoritative clean protocol design: immutable factory and isolated clones, NFT escrow, entry tickets, outcome economics and rounding, draw and refund deadlines, settlement/redemption, independent claims, trust boundaries, and advisory frontend discovery.

Raffle lifecycle and API semantics, entry ranges and bearer tickets, draw timing and callback handling, settlement and redemption, refund batches, payouts, destination restrictions, state queries and events.
Immutable factory configuration, atomic raffle creation and prize escrow, sponsor parameters and validation, and canonical raffle registry queries.
Fixed v1 price, six-decimal token precision, fee and cash-winner percentages, sponsor remainder, refund batch bound, maximum sale duration, draw timeouts, and VRF parameters.

Raffle implementation NatSpec adds constant-time entry operations, locked implementation and isolated clone storage, native-transfer rejection, exact prize acceptance, ticket destination checks, callback behavior, storage-only settlement, and quote-token assumptions.
Factory implementation NatSpec specifies immutable ownerless operation, deployment dependency checks and canonical token assumptions, atomic creation, and supported prize validation.
